deliverables.description: Per-endpoint circuit breaker with three states (closed/open/half_open). SQLite WAL-backed, thread-safe with retry-on-busy. Tracks failure counts per endpoint, transitions to OPEN after configurable threshold, auto-recovers via HALF_OPEN test calls after timeout. Includes event log for audit trail, manual reset capability, and bus notifications on state transitions.

Graph-based cycle detection for pipelines, help requests, and work queues. Uses DFS with back-edge detection (WHITE/GRAY/BLACK coloring). Reads from existing SQLite tables without creating its own schema. Supports three resolution strategies: timeout (break oldest), priority (break lowest priority), random. Resolution atomically releases blocked resources.

Background timer framework implementing SOP-012v2 escalation policies. Four timer types: BLOCKER_ESCALATION (3min), IDLE_AGENT_REASSIGNMENT (1min), STALL_ALERT (3min), DEPENDENCY_TIMEOUT (5min). SQLite-backed for crash recovery. Background daemon thread checks for expired timers. Generates structured escalation actions with severity and recommended_actions. Publishes to bus on fire. Supports callbacks per timer type.

scenarios_verified: No false positives on DAG (no cycles)
Timer starts and appears in active list
Expired timer fires with correct escalation action
Fired timers removed from active list

design_decisions: All three modules follow the existing Proto A patterns: SQLite WAL mode, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, _retry_on_busy decorator with capped exponential backoff, threading.Lock for connection safety
Circuit breaker uses its own table (circuit_breaker) rather than sharing coordinator_hub tables, enabling independent deployment
Deadlock detector reads from existing tables (pipelines, pipeline_stages, help_requests, work_queue) without schema changes -- pure read-only analysis except for resolution actions
Escalation timer storage is SQLite-backed for crash recovery rather than in-memory only, per SOP-012v2 requirement for persistence
Escalation actions are structured dicts with severity levels and recommended_actions lists, enabling automated coordinator responses
All modules publish to the JSONL bus using the same atomic-append pattern as coordinator_hub.py and help_protocol.py
DFS cycle detection uses the standard WHITE/GRAY/BLACK vertex coloring algorithm -- O(V+E) time complexity
integration_notes: CircuitBreaker.call_allowed() should be called BEFORE rate_limiter checks to fail fast on broken endpoints
DeadlockDetector.scan_all() can be wired into the coordinator heartbeat loop for periodic scanning
EscalationTimerManager.start_monitor_thread() starts a daemon thread that integrates with coordinator_hub without blocking
EscalationTimerManager callbacks dict allows the coordinator to register handlers per timer type for automated response
